entities.summary: Robert Bruce Dickson was a Canadian ice hockey player. He was a member of the Edmonton Mercurys that won a gold medal at the 1952 Winter Olympics in Oslo, Norway. Dickson moved later to Littleton, Colorado in the United States. He died in Colorado on December 1, 2023, at the age of 92. At the time of his death, he was the last living member of 1952 Canadian Olympic ice hockey team.
